Need to know

Frequently asked questions

How do I request a commission?

Use the commission inquiry button to contact ShadowStar. Include your idea, references, desired avatar platform, and any deadline.

What affects the price?

Price depends on complexity, requested features, and scope. A quote will be discussed before work begins.

Can I request my own FNAF character?

Yes! We only accept FNAF-based avatars. Bring your OC references, color palette, clothing ideas, and specific features you want preserved.

Are commissions always open?

Availability may change. Contact us to ask about current commission slots before placing an order.
